title: Mann durch Schuss aus mutmaßlicher Schreckschusswaffe und Reizgas verletzt

extraction.summaryEn: A 23-year-old man was attacked on the U2 platform at Alexanderplatz station; one of three assailants allegedly fired a blank-firing gun into his face, then they sprayed him with pepper spray and fled. He was injured in the eyes and skin and taken to hospital.
